title: One Inbox: the bell, the Console alerts and the menu all open /inbox, and /notifications redirects

source.ref: Plans and calendar clarity audit 2026-11-25 (project thread: Audit the project and calendar system; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/GUTHmChGkqaEmPSRUdzJHz)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-25: /notifications and /inbox list the same notices. The member shell, the Space console and the admin console all link /notifications; /inbox is reachable only from a button on /notifications and from /admin/work. Fix: /notifications redirects to /inbox (Mark all as read moves there), every bell and alert link opens /inbox.
